Register code/mock batch and external gates. Preserve root live-access prohibition until separate real-run authority. Check installed Python/Node/pnpm/uv/browser and existing lock. Do not rebuild baseline or upgrade toolchain.

Read old LV mapping and v1 configuration. Record this package as the v2 batching/secret/capture seam amendment. Missing final A evidence blocks real activation but not independent mock implementation.

tasks.title: Implement global attempt reservation, shared quota ledger and estimator
interfaces: quota.py::QuotaLedger.reserve_attempt(scope_id: str, purpose: str, now_utc: datetime, now_mono: float) -> Reservation | Denied
quota.py::QuotaLedger.finalize_attempt(reservation_id: str, outcome: str, headers: Mapping[str, str]) -> None
poll_budget.py::estimate_requests(segments: Sequence[PollSegment], setup: int, confirmations: int, fallback_calls: int, reserve_fraction: Decimal) -> BudgetEstimate
steps: Use supplied DDL for persistent attempt reservations; one provider slot and process lock. Reservation commit precedes HTTP; unknown/failure is never refunded automatically.
Implement6000/day600/session6/sliding60s10s minimum gap andin-flight1. Provider headers reduce available allowance. Renew day only with consistent quota evidence, no wall-clock rollback bypass.
Count setup, status, retries, fallback, manual refresh as attempts. Preflight estimates using union of monitor windows, not per-fixture multiplication for simultaneous batch.
Test two processes cannot each reserve beyond cap and second process cannot start a parallel poller.500/429/timeout count even when provider billing unknown.
tests: uv run --frozen --offline python -m pytest -q tests/live/test_provider_budget.py tests/live/test_quota_concurrency.py
acceptance: The arithmetic oracle returns 480 periodic calls + 5 overhead = 485 and 582 with a 20% retry reserve. Five concurrent fixtures share that total; five sequential windows total 2,425. Five event fallbacks add 600 calls and exceed the default session cap.
tasks.example:
assert budget_for_120min_constant15s == 485
assert reserve20percent_budget == 582
assert quota.seventh_attempt_in_60_seconds_allowed is False

tasks.title: Normalize football snapshots and preserve correction/missingness lineage
interfaces: football_normalizer.py::normalize_bundle(response: ProviderResponse, selected: Sequence[int], observation: ObservationStamp) -> BundleProjection
steps: Map only allowed fields from02_PROVIDER and04_CONTRACTS. kickoff timestamp is not update time; null clock/score remains null. Preserve selected-but-missing IDs as missing observation facts.
Create normalized immutable event multiset with deterministic ordering and duplicate multiplicity. Retain batch receipt separately from semantic content revision.
Change/removal of goal/card creates correction revision; never incrementally accumulate every poll. Unknown man-state and event detail stay unknown rather than guessing.
Drop unneeded players/stats/lineups bodies; record availability only. No extra endpoints to fetch dropped data. Redacted persisted output strict schema validates.

acceptance: Reordering an unchanged event multiset preserves its semantic hash. Null differs from zero. An omitted fixture cannot corrupt another fixture. Score/period conflicts remain explicit.

assert normalize(response_with_null_goals).score_current is None
assert event_hash([event_a, event_b]) == event_hash([event_b, event_a])
assert normalize(response).provider_updated_at is None  # kickoff is not update time

tasks.title: Implement one adaptive ProviderBundlePoller for the complete watchlist
steps: Apply exact status/deadline table from02_PROVIDER, fastest-active union for<=5. One shared in-flight request; no requests on UI re-render/panel reopen.
Full watcher IDs included at each due tick, numeric sort/dedupe; status/coverage/terminal controls recorded. Observe terminal once then+30/+120 checks bounded by run deadline.
No catch-up after missed ticks; rejected/budget exhausted/unknownquota =>visiblePAUSED/STALE. Manual refresh coalesces. Fallback events defaultOFF and cannot activate from empty array.
Use fake clock and mock transport to count requests for single/five simultaneous, staggered windows, HT/live overlap, slow HTTP,429, sleep/resume and fallback insufficiency.

for second in range(7200):

assert http.bundle_calls == 480  # all five kept1H/2H in this synthetic schedule

Replay frozen actual live payloads/control timestamps into new DB using same reducer; compare independent readback, never copy derived rows.

Implement the security case matrix: redirects/proxy, secret leakage, permission/module graph, fixed read-only DOM operations, wire roles and unexpected outbound destinations.

Validate artifact references and current source/config/profile hashes. Missing or synthetic evidence produces named pending conditions. A changed enabled dependency requires its tests and review again.
